description: This file is a shell script containing tests for whitespace handling and patch application logic in git. It includes function definitions, test setup, and numerous test cases for different whitespace and patch application scenarios.

methods.name: prepare_test_file
methods.description: Prepares a test file with specific whitespace characters and patterns to test whitespace rules.

methods.name: apply_patch
methods.description: Applies a patch with optional whitespace enforcement and failure handling.

methods.name: test_fix
methods.description: Tests the whitespace fix application and the diff output to verify correct patch application.
